notes.title: Try my other game: Rats in a Cage
notes.content:
[p]Thank you all for playing Covid Tale: Ignorance. It was a fun time-killing game project. 
But now I've released a proper game on STEAM called [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085890/Rats_in_a_Cage/" style="button"]Rats in a Cage[/url] it's a satire puzzle game with tons of unexpected things, dark humor, workplace jokes, amazing music done by my brother, and stylish graphics done by my wife. Please give it a try. Demo is available as well, so you can try it and decide if you want to buy it or not.[/p][p]

Make a coffee and have fun! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37658385/663a26291e1dc455c3c926c23984b3beab06b5e0.png"][/img][/p]
